channel.title: Engineering Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of engineering blog posts from top tech companies

item.title: Distributed LLM Training Across Metros: Streaming DiLoCo in MaxText
item.description: Streaming DiLoCo in MaxText enables developers to efficiently train large language models across geographically distributed TPU slices by streaming parameter fragments instead of synchronizing full models at every step This approach slashes cross-slice communication volume by over 60× and eliminates network stalls, allowing seamless multi-datacenter scaling without degrading model convergence or quality.

item.title: nginx2root: Five new nginx vulnerabilities, and how Cloudflare protects origins from the worst of them
item.description: Five memory corruption bugs in nginx, called nginx2root, can let an unauthenticated attacker run code on a server Here’s how they work, and why origins behind Cloudflare's proxy are shielded from the most serious of these bugs.

item.title: Give your agents controlled access to analyze your data and move funds
item.description: Stripe Treasury now lets agents transfer funds, convert currencies, and pay vendors within limits you set Give agents the access they need to help run your business, with customizable controls and human approvals.
